market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to remain under pressure into RBA decision; fourth hike priced in. Housing data and mortgage rate spikes will dominate. Commodity strength (oil, gold) provides partial offset. Small-caps outperform on momentum. Expect volatility around 10% house price forecasts.
market_outlook.long_term: Bull case returns per macrobusiness but contingent on RBA pausing post-hike cycle. AI/tech capex supercycle and commodity rotation support medium-term upside. Housing correction may take 12-18 months to stabilise. Energy transition and EV adoption create structural winners. Australia's per-capita GDP stall vs Canada warrants policy reform.
